_doc: Every entry git tracks at the repository root, each with a one-line reason. scripts/check_root_hygiene.mjs fails on a root entry that is not listed here and on a listed entry that no longer exists. Adding a root file is a reviewed decision: add its line here in the same commit. Entries whose reason starts with 'REVIEW:' are kept only until the owner decides; nothing references them as a working input.

entries..agents: Agent skills of the hardening workflow (crash-triage, dataflow-audit, determinism-fixer, mutant-killer, perf-guard)
entries..ai-devkit.json: AI DevKit manifest read by the dev-* skills under .claude/skills
entries..claude: Claude Code project settings, hooks (rustfmt-on-edit) and skills
entries..gitattributes: Git attributes: LF line endings for generated licence, NOTICE, SBOM and manifest files
entries..hardening.env: Configuration of the hardening workflow (just verify), see AGENTS.md
entries..project.json: workspace-catalogue metadata (name, category, command) for the owner's tooling; kept by owner decision 2026-11-24 (root-hygiene review)
entries.BENCHMARK_BASELINE.md: Benchmark baseline and how to read benchmark_report.json
entries.BIOME_TAXONOMY.md: Biome taxonomy referenced by PROJECT.md and SIMULATION_RULES.md
entries.CITATION.cff: Citation metadata (CFF 1.2) that GitHub reads for "Cite this repository"; added in #56
entries.CLAUDE.md: Standing guidance for Claude Code sessions
entries.COORDINATE_CONTRACT.md: Coordinate-system contract referenced by PROJECT.md and SIMULATION_RULES.md
entries.CREATURE_MORPHOGENESIS.md: Redirect stub to docs/explanation/CREATURE_MORPHOGENESIS.md and the creature development contract
entries.NOTICE: Third-party notices, regenerated by scripts/gen_notice.mjs and checked by check:notice
entries.README.md: README in English, the default GitHub shows
entries.TODO.md: Work log in reverse chronological order
entries.WORLD_DESIGN.md: World design document linked from both READMEs
entries.animal-map.manifest.json: Map 1 manifest validated by the animal-map-vision gate
entries.artifacts: Experiment, world and map artifacts checked by tests and check:e2
entries.benchmark_report.json: Sample benchmark report described in BENCHMARK_BASELINE.md
entries.dataflow.json: Expected module dependency graph, checked by the CI step 'Module dependency graph matches dataflow.json'
entries.justfile: Recipes of the hardening workflow (just verify), see AGENTS.md
entries.licensing: Third-party licence texts and the bundle closure, checked by check:licenses
entries.map-views: Eight 1280x720 PNG renders of Map 1, listed with their hashes in map_manifest.json
entries.map_config.json: Map configuration read at startup by src-tauri/src/core/terrain.rs
entries.map_manifest.json: World manifest regenerated by gen:world-manifest and hashed by tests/frontend/mapManifestEvidence.test.ts
entries.package-lock.json: npm lockfile of the root package
entries.playground: Scratch area (QD-D, 2026-10-31): RabbitVisualizer.tsx, typechecked by npm run build
entries.sbom.cdx.json: CycloneDX SBOM, checked by check:sbom and check:sbom-schema
entries.schemas: Vendored CycloneDX 1.5 schemas used by check:sbom-schema
entries.src-tauri: Rust workspace: the anima-engine package and crates/anima-domain
entries.tests: Second npm package: Vitest and Playwright suites
entries.world_smoke.ts: worldGen v11 smoke harness, kept for tuning until World v2 replaces worldGen in the app (WV2-7); owner decision 2026-11-24 (root-hygiene review)
